data_provenance: Deterministic synthetic data, seed 20261026; no real customer data.
business_rules: Active accounts have account_status='active'; trials are excluded.
MRR is the sum of monthly_contract_value_inr for active accounts.
Billed revenue includes paid and open invoices and excludes void invoices.
Cash collected is paid_amount_inr on paid invoices only.
Overdue receivables are open invoices due before 2026-10-01.
Unresolved support tickets have status open or in_progress.
All INR amounts are illustrative synthetic scenario values.
